name: Brown Sugar Muffins
notes: AKA “Good Boy Muffins”, as certain boys get these if they are good boys in church.

steps.title: Cream the butter and sugar
steps.body: Cream **½ cup butter** and **1 cup brown sugar**.

steps.title: Add the egg and seasonings
steps.body: Add **1 egg**, **1 tsp vanilla**, **1 tsp baking soda** and **¼ tsp salt**.

steps.title: Mix in the milk and flour
steps.body: Alternate adding, and mix in: **1 cup milk** and **2 cups flour**.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Place in muffin tins and bake at 375°F for 10–15 minutes.
